answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. A karst of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The saffron of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
